Final grade calculator

Find the exam score you need to reach your target course grade.

Your result will appear here.

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Enter your current grade excluding the final, your target course grade and the final exam’s percentage weight. Required exam score = (target − current × (1 − weight)) ÷ weight, where weight is written as a decimal. This assumes the final is the only ungraded component.

Try this example

Current grade 82%, target 85%, final weight 30%: you need 92% on the final.

How your data is handled ↗What grade do I need on my final exam? ↗

Good to know

What if the required score is over 100%?

The target is not reachable with an ordinary 0–100% final under these assumptions. A score at or below zero means the target is already met mathematically, but attendance, minimum-exam marks and other syllabus rules may still apply.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
